f55500d513febf84.description: Data Analyst Location: Pune Experience: 0-1 Year About EnKash EnKash is a leading B2B fintech company revolutionizing corporate spend management and payments. It offers a unified platform for payables, receivables, corporate cards, and expense management. Backed by key RBI licenses including Payment Aggregator and PPI Issuer, EnKash enables businesses to automate financial operations with compliance and control. About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our Product team. This is a product-aligned role that goes beyond routine reporting and focuses on using data to understand product performance, customer behaviour, transaction trends, and improvement opportunities. Key Responsibilities:  Collect, clean, validate, and analyze product, customer, transaction, and business data.  Create and maintain dashboards, MIS reports, and trackers for key product and operational metrics.  Monitor product adoption, usage, conversion, drop-offs, transaction trends, and customer behaviour.  Support the Product Manager with data and insights for product reviews, feature prioritization, and decision-making.  Identify trends, anomalies, gaps, and improvement opportunities through structured analysis.  Measure and report the impact of product launches, feature enhancements, and process changes.  Coordinate with Product, Technology, Operations, and other teams to understand data requirements and ensure data accuracy.  Translate product and business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate actionable insights. Required Skills & Qualifications  Bachelors degree in any Engineering discipline, or in Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.  0-1 year of relevant experience; fresh graduates with strong internships, academic projects, or hands-on analytics exposure may also apply.  Working knowledge of SQL and strong proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets.  Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or a similar data visualization tool.  Basic understanding of data cleaning, analysis, interpretation, dashboarding, and reporting.  Strong numerical aptitude, logical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.  Ability to communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.  Interest in digital products, customer journeys, fintech, or payments is preferred.  Basic knowledge of Python or another analytical programming language will be an added advantage. Why Join EnKash?  Opportunity to work in a fast-growing B2B fintech environment.  Direct exposure to product analytics, customer behaviour, and data-driven product decision-making.  Hands-on learning across payment products, transactions, dashboards, and product metrics.  A strong career-growth path to take ownership of product insights and become a key pillar of the Product department.  Collaborative and high-ownership work culture.
